notes: Starting cards per the strategy's Starting line (no separate starting section; all are in the list and count toward the 60): Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself, Death Star: Detention Block Corridor, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Yavin 4: Docking Bay, Yavin 4: Massassi War Room, and The Signal (starting Interrupt) for Echo Base Garrison. Against Scum the strategy starts Seeking An Audience instead of Echo Base Garrison.
The description says the deck went 3-1 at the CA State Championship (2001 California State Championship); no wiki event page exists yet.

Posted 'Death Star Detention Block Corridor' dested the Light Special Edition site Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (Special Edition), the one Rescue The Princess deploys (the Premiere printing is Dark).
Posted 'Blast The Door, Kid' dested Blast The Door, Kid!; 'Fall Back' dested Fall Back!; 'Rescue The Princess/Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself' dested the objective.

Staging Areas is the plain Effect (the Your Insight Serves You Well combo is Reflections III, later than this post). The strategy also mentions I Hope She's Alright and Home One as space-meta additions; they are not in the list.
